warnings.message: 271 of 365 events are synthetic neutral contacts generated for metric and interface validation. Captured terminal events, scores and rally outcomes are unchanged. Exclude this match from real multi-match analysis (dataClass = TEST_FIXTURE).

Set lineups and the first server of set 2 are inferred, not captured: the v1 export stores one starting rotation for the whole match. They are consistent with the captured services and blocks, which is supporting evidence, not proof.
Opponent actions carry no action type and no player.

Libero swaps are not logged in v1. They are derived with the standard rule: the libero replaces the back-row middle blocker and never serves, so the middle blocker at position 1 serves while the own team serves.
